name: acs_income_exact_reference_tail
notes: Reconstruction configuration; no original trained weights or unreleased pool IDs are claimed.
The generic exact-reference-tail backend performs full continuation checks and has different compute costs from the native arxiv tube backend.

California to five states is the manuscript's setting; the particular target states and 2018 survey year here are declared example choices because the paper omits them. T=8, width 64 and optimizer settings are reconstruction choices. The residual tanh MLP uses identity transport and its actual nonlinear continuation. This benchmark measures predictive accuracy and does not establish a fairness or causal claim.
Full: 512 calibration calls per configured depth per member, 512 selection calls per member, and 2048 final audit calls; smoke uses explicitly synthetic fixtures.
